units.source_text: 因此，那一刻，堀木的住址和姓名從記憶的深處浮現出來，隨手寫在了信箋上。

en.t: And so, at that moment, Horiki's address and full name rose up from the depths of my memory, and I casually wrote them on the stationery.

units.source_text: 離開比目魚的家，徒步來到新宿，賣掉隨身攜帶的書，然後便茫然地不知該去往何處。

en.t: I left Flounder's house, walked to Shinjuku, sold the books I had with me, and then stood there in a daze, not knowing where to go.

units.source_text: 我對每個人都很友善，但從未切身感受過「友情」。

en.t: I was friendly to everyone, but I had never truly felt anything like friendship.

units.source_text: 堀木這樣的狐朋狗友除外，其他的一切交往帶給我的只有痛苦，

en.t: Apart from disreputable companions like Horiki, every other association brought me nothing but pain,

units.source_text: 為了排遣那種痛苦，我拼命地扮演丑角，反而讓我精疲力竭。

en.t: and in order to dispel that pain, I desperately played the clown, only to leave myself utterly exhausted.

units.source_text: 只要看到熟悉的面孔，哪怕是模樣相似的面孔，我都會大吃一驚，

en.t: Whenever I saw a familiar face, or even a face that merely resembled one, I would be startled,

units.source_text: 就會被那種令人暈眩的戰慄襲遍全身。

en.t: and a dizzying shudder would sweep through my entire body.
